svg.aria-label: Ebbtide MCP: long-term memory for AI agents that forgets on purpose, an MCP server whose memories fade unless recalled. I compared six memory policies on the LongMemEval and LoCoMo benchmarks. The drawing shows retention decaying and each recall resetting it with a slower decay.
